about: The priest addresses Jesus Christ, the Son of the living God. He recalls the work of salvation accomplished through Christ's death, by the will of the Father and with the cooperation of the Holy Spirit. He asks to be delivered from iniquity and evil, to remain faithful to the commandments, and never to be separated from Christ.

s01.translation: Lord Jesus Christ, Son of the living God,

s02.translation: who by the will of the Father and the work of the Holy Spirit, through Your Death gave life to the world:

s03.translation: free me by this, Your most holy Body and Blood, from all my sins and from every evil:

s04.translation: keep me always faithful to Your commandments, and never let me be parted from You:

s05.translation: Who with the same God the Father and the Holy Spirit live and reign, God, for ever and ever. Amen.

w011.function: Deponent participle forming an ablative absolute with “Spíritu” (w012).

w020.function: From this point the prayer remains in the first person singular.

w027.function: Agrees with “Sánguinem” (w026). In sense it qualifies both Body and Blood.

w034.function: Neuter plural noun: evils, not evil men.

w047.function: Subjunctive expressing a petition, negated by “numquam” (w045).

w050.function: Agrees with “Deo” (w051) and points back to God the Father named earlier.
